rank_math_description: Maryland small claims in 2026: $5,000 limit, $44 filing fee, $60 sheriff or $20 mail service, informal trials, 30-day appeals, 10% interest.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> District Court location -> Complaint/Application and Affidavit -> $44 + service ($60 sheriff / $20 mail) -> notice of intention to defend -> informal trial (no discovery) -> 30-day appeal (de novo) -> oral exam / garnishment / execution / lien
